title: Data Quality Audit and Bivariate Temperature-Humidity Analysis of a Long-Term LoRaWAN Network: Anomaly Detection, PCA, Clustering and Machine Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-term environmental IoT/LPWAN deployments often aggregate heterogeneous data streams from diverse devices without systematic auditing of each variable's actual coverage prior to analysis-an increased risk when multiple sensor types coexist within the same network. This work proposes a C++17 processing pipeline applied to the Tour Perret LoRaWAN dataset (421 937 frames, June 2021--June 2023, 5 devices). A systematic coverage audit integrated into the extraction phase reveals that CO2 is completely missing (0% coverage) and pressure is reported only by an isolated base module (Wyres, 4.24% of the corpus), invalidating the initial hypothesis of a joint four-variable analysis. The analysis is refocused on the Temperature--Humidity pair, jointly available across 205{,}005 frames (95.76%) from 4 Elsys EMS sensors. translated_title: 长期LoRaWAN网络的数据质量审计与温度-湿度双变量分析：异常检测、主成分分析、聚类与机器学习
translated_abstract: 长期环境物联网/LPWAN部署通常会聚合来自多种设备的异构数据流，但在分析之前并未对各变量的实际数据覆盖情况进行系统性审计——当多种传感器类型共存于同一网络时，这种风险会进一步加大。本工作提出了一种C++17处理流水线，并应用于Tour Perret LoRaWAN数据集（421,937帧数据，2021年6月至2023年6月，5个设备）。集成于数据提取阶段的系统性覆盖审计显示，CO2完全缺失（覆盖率0%），气压数据仅由一个孤立的基础模块（Wyres，占语料库的4.24%）上报，这使最初进行四变量联合分析的假设不成立。因此，分析重新聚焦于温度-湿度变量对，二者在来自4个Elsys EMS传感器的205,005帧数据（95.76%）中联合可用。该流水线依次执行异常检测（修正Z分数法、孤立森林算法）、双变量主成分分析（PCA）、聚类以及机器学习分析。
tldr: 该研究提出一种C++17处理流水线，通过对长期LoRaWAN数据集进行系统性变量覆盖审计，发现CO2数据完全缺失、气压覆盖率极低，从而将分析重新聚焦于覆盖率高达95.76%的温度-湿度变量对，并结合异常检测、主成分分析、聚类与机器学习方法开展双变量分析。
en_tdlr: This work proposes a C++17 processing pipeline that systematically audits variable coverage in a long-term LoRaWAN dataset, revealing completely missing CO2 data and sparse pressure readings, and refocuses the analysis on the jointly-available temperature-humidity pair (95.76% coverage) through anomaly detection, PCA, clustering and machine learning.
